description: Search a term over the last 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d or 365d (range, default 7d) without creating a keyword: each platform that can search that far back is read once (past 30d linkedin, tiktok, facebook, threads, web, substack and instagram are skipped with reason window) (platforms to narrow; at most 25 results a platform) and every result is scored for relevance, sentiment and intents against the company profile, with kind (brand, competitor, topic: the default) and context telling the classifier what the term is. Results stay apart from the mentions: no alert, digest or report sees them. Billed $0.008 per scored result; the workspace must have topped up at least once (else funding_required) and the balance must cover the maximum (maxCostCents) (else insufficient_balance). At most 10 searches an hour. Returns the search queued: poll get_search until status is done (usually a minute or two), then read list_search_results.

context.description: A sentence the classifier reads for this search only, on top of the company profile: what the term means here, what to ignore.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

kind.description: What the term is to you, as on a keyword: brand (your company or product), competitor, or topic (the default). The classifier judges relevance with it.

platforms.description: Platforms to read; omit for all that search back in time (bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, reddit, x, youtube, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, facebook, podcasts, web, substack, threads, mastodon). devto, news and producthunt are skipped.

range.description:
How far back the search reads, ending now. See [Search](/guides/search#platforms).

- 24h, 7d, 30d: every platform (instagram at most 7 days).
- 90d, 365d: only platforms reaching that far; the others are skipped (window).

term.description: The word or phrase to search, case-insensitive, matched as the phrase (written joined or as a hashtag counts). Quotes are not needed.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
